basic_details.job_title: GGSMCH Project Nurse-II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital (GGSMCH) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Project Nurse-II. The position is temporary and project-based up to 31-01-27, with a pay of Rs. 22,000 per month. Applicants must hold a Three Year General Nursing and Midwife(GNM) Course from a Recognized University and pass Punjabi up to Matric standard. Candidates must apply offline by sending the completed application form along with fee and self-attested documents by hand or post to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, Faridkot before 15 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form from the official notification.
Enclose a non-refundable demand draft in favour of The Registrar, Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot, payable at Faridkot (Rs. 1,770 for General Category and Rs. 885 for SC Category).
Attach self-attested copies of certificates for proof of date of birth, marks sheets, degree, experience, nursing council registration, and other relevant documents.

Send the completed application form along with the fee and self-attested documents by hand or post to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, Faridkot, before 15 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.
Candidates already in service must route their application through the proper channel. Use a separate application form for each post.

content_sections.heading: GGSMCH Project Nurse-II at a Glance

rows.details: Guru Gobind Singh Medical College and Hospital (GGSMCH)
Tele-school Health led Epilepsy Smart Schools in India: An Implementation Initiative with Mixed Method Assessment (Tele_ESSI)
Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi
Rs. 20,000/- per month + 10% HRA (Rs. 2,000) = Rs. 22,000/- per month
Below 30 years on the date of interview
General: Rs. 1,770 (Fee Rs. 1,500 + GST Rs. 270 @ 18%); SC: Rs. 885 (Fee Rs. 750 + GST Rs. 135 @ 18%)

rows.essential_qualification: Minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA Three Year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) Course from a Recognized University. Must have passed Punjabi up to Matric standard.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience of Trial/ Studies for 2 years or equivalent knowledge of computers.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month plus 10% HRA (Rs. 2,000), making a total of Rs. 22,000/- per month. The tenure of the project is based on performance and availability of funds under the research project, running strictly up to 31-01-27 on a purely temporary basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GGSMCH Project Nurse-II
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the official notification. Enclose a non-refundable demand draft in favour of The Registrar, Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot, payable at Faridkot (Rs. 1,770 for General Category and Rs. 885 for SC Category). Attach self-attested copies of certificates for proof of date of birth, marks sheets, degree, experience, nursing council registration, and other relevant documents. Send the completed application form along with the fee and self-attested documents by hand or post to the Principal Office, Guru Gobind Singh Medical College, Faridkot, before 15 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Candidates already in service must route their application through the proper channel. Use a separate application form for each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be carried out through a walk-in interview. Candidates must report to the Principal Office on 16 October 2026 by 9:00 AM for document verification and must carry all original documents.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Project Nurse-II post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is purely on a temporary and contract basis under the ICMR research project up to 31-01-27, depending on performance and fund availability.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base salary?
faq.answer: Yes, the salary includes Rs. 20,000/- per month plus 10% HRA (Rs. 2,000), bringing the total remuneration to Rs. 22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for this position?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include 2 years of experience in trials or studies, or equivalent knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q4. What documents and items are required on the day of the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report to the Principal Office carrying all original documents for verification on 16 October 2026 by 9:00 AM, along with self-attested copies attached to their application.
